Comment.value: Caster Signature Gear - Damage Retyper (roadmap: Gear-to-boost-specific-mage-spells). Effect is scripted in cg_retype_inc.nss, keyed off this Tag. Deliberately not placed anywhere yet - acquisition is an open design question.

value.0:
A fragment of scrying-glass from a tower where the wise once went to dream, and did not always wake. A conjured terror is a poor weapon against a thing with no mind to terrify and no death to fear. The Dreamshard finishes the illusion instead of leaving it half-made: the Weird it shapes is no longer a phantom asking permission to kill, but a bolt of unanswerable magical force, and neither an iron will nor a deathless body turns it aside.

Worn at the neck. Its power sleeps for any who is not a Wizard.
